$comment: Every allowed path. Areas are a CLOSED list (XENO LOCAL HOME - SPEC.md section 5); a new area is a spec change. Entries are registered per (kind, area); everything inside an area belongs to its owner. 'locks' entries are run-kind directories that may hold lock files only (spec section 8).

areas.responsibility: the person's XENO account, device identity, sign-in state
the user-level corpus: rules, skills, documents, claims, verdicts, history
installed agent versions, isolated agent homes

kindNotes.data: durable profile and runtime identity, and acquisition metadata (what was pinned, from where, with which digest)
kindNotes.cache: re-downloadable runtime bytes; deleting it must leave a product that re-acquires from the data record

areas.responsibility: local replicas of workspaces, teams and assignments
one creative app's own settings, recent files, window state
installed-product registry, updates, crash reports, running-service records

kindNotes.state: includes migrations/ (the migration journal, spec section 10)

locks.$comment: Spec section 8: locks live in run/<area>/. Every area may hold locks regardless of its 'uses' list; a locks-only run entry accepts <name>.lock files and nothing else.
